intro-1.text: Writing a good customer email, then building the buttons to go in it, takes time. The CLICK-zenn Online Template Generator does both for you, for free.

intro-2.text: Pick a few options, and it writes a ready-to-paste Zendesk email with CLICK-zenn buttons already laid out.

build-1.text: Open the generator and start on the left. When does the email go out? We'll choose Solved.

build-2.text: What should the customer do? Confirm it's fixed. Then pick a tone: Friendly or Professional.

build-3.text: The preview on the right updates as you go: a subject, a message, and buttons that fit. Show sample data fills in example values.

build-4.text: Prefer a head start? Pick one of the ready-made templates instead, for approvals, refunds, escalations and more.

build-5.text: Under Making it a working email, open What each button does, to see exactly what every button will do to the ticket.

download-1.text: The buttons start out as placeholders. To make them work, click Download buttons.

download-2.text: You get one button file, with each button's text, colors and actions already set.

import-1.text: In CLICK-zenn, under Available CLICK-buttons, click Import buttons, and choose that file.

import-2.text: Each button is listed with a short summary of what it does. Click Import.

import-3.text: CLICK-zenn creates them all in one step, and shows each button's HTML, ready to copy.

link-1.text: Back in the generator, paste each button's HTML into the box next to it.

link-2.text: The preview switches to your real CLICK-zenn buttons, and the note confirms: All buttons are linked.

zendesk-1.text: Now click Copy HTML. This email goes out when a ticket is solved, so it belongs in a trigger.

zendesk-2.text: Paste it into the trigger's Email body, use the generator's subject, and save.

result-1.text: Your customer gets a clear, friendly email, with two simple choices.

result-2.text: One click on Yes, all set, and they land on a thank-you page. Nothing to type.

result-3.text: Back in Zendesk, the answer is already on the ticket, with no reply to read.

outro-1.text: A finished email and working buttons, in minutes.

outro-2.text: Try the free Online Template Generator, and find CLICK-zenn on the Zendesk Marketplace.
